fixed.summary: A popover is a raised panel again (--panel-raised and the panel radius; a hint the tooltip's), as a browser's popover has its own canvas: one without a CSS background no longer draws its text straight over the page. Its CSS overrides that box.
A context menu, opened at a point, draws no ::-og-arrow: its corner sits at the point, as a desktop's and a game's context menus do.
A <menu>'s buttons (its menu items) each span the menu, so a context menu's rows are as wide as each other instead of their labels' widths.
